Compression codec selection and payload encode helpers.Map an Accept-Encoding token like gzip, br or zstd to its CompressionEncoding value.Return the header token for a CompressionEncoding, such as br or zstd.Fast path for choosing a compression encoding from raw Accept-Encoding characters without q-value parsing.Accepted encodings ordered by client q-value, with server tie-breaker zstd preferred over br and gzip.Choose the best compression encoding from an Accept-Encoding header string.Choose the best compression encoding from a FastStringView Accept-Encoding value.Compress the payload with gzip at the given level, clamped to the libdeflate range.Compress the payload with brotli, choosing the encoder mode from the content type.Compress the payload with zstd at the mapped compression level.Compress the payload with the given encoding, returning it unchanged for ceNone.
